title: Fruit Stand – Free Cosy Idle Shop Game in Your Browser
description: Play Fruit Stand free: pick fruit, stock your shelves, serve customers and hire helpers to grow a tiny orchard stand into a busy city market.
body: Walk around your little stand, pick apples straight from the trees, fill the shelves and collect the coins your customers leave at the counter. Spend them on new trees, new fruit, a bigger basket, faster shoes and helpers who keep working while you are away.

There are three stands to finish: an orchard stand, a village market and a city market with watermelons and a juice machine. Finish the city market to start again with a permanent sales bonus. Your progress is saved automatically.
It plays with one finger, a mouse or the arrow keys, in portrait or landscape, on phones, tablets, Chromebooks and computers. New here? Read how to play and the tips to grow faster.

title: How to Play Fruit Stand – Controls, Customers, Helpers and Stands
description: Fruit Stand controls and rules: drag anywhere to walk, pick fruit, stock shelves, take payments at the counter and buy upgrades by standing on the price mats.
body: Moving. On a phone or tablet, put your finger anywhere on the screen and drag: a small joystick appears under your finger. With a mouse, click and drag. On a keyboard, use the arrow keys or WASD. Everything else happens when you walk next to things.

Picking. Walk next to a tree with fruit and your character picks it, one piece at a time, until your arms are full. The number of pieces you can carry grows with the backpack upgrade. You only pick fruit that one of your shelves sells.
Stocking. Walk next to a shelf and the matching fruit jumps onto it. Customers come in, wait at the shelf with a little bubble showing what they want, take it and queue at the counter.
Getting paid. Stand behind the counter (at the till) and the queue pays one by one. Coins pile up next to the counter: walk over the pile to collect them. Every few customers also leave a star.

Buying. Dashed mats with a price appear around the stand. Stand on one and your coins flow into it; when the price reaches zero, the thing is built: a new tree, a new shelf, a bigger backpack, faster shoes, a helper (orange cap) who picks and stocks for you, or a cashier (purple cap) who takes payments.

Stands. The last mat of each stand is a signpost: buy it to open the next stand. After the third one, the star mat starts you again from the first stand with a permanent bonus on every sale. Stars buy aprons, hats and awning colours in the shop on the main menu.

title: Fruit Stand Tips: Grow Your Market Faster
description: Practical tips for Fruit Stand: what to buy first, when to hire helpers, how to keep the queue moving and how to make the most of offline earnings.
body: Buy the cheap tree first. The first mat costs only a few coins and doubles how fast you can refill the apple shelf. The backpack comes next: carrying more fruit means fewer trips.
Do not let the queue grow. Customers only pay when someone is at the till. Fill the shelves, then pop behind the counter for a few seconds, then collect the coin pile on your way back.
Fill the emptiest shelf. Customers are drawn to shelves that have fruit, but each one only waits at its own shelf. A full apple shelf does not help the customer waiting for bananas.

Hire helpers early. Helpers never stop working: they always restock the emptiest shelf. They also keep the stand earning while you are away, so the game gives you a share of those coins when you come back (up to two hours).
The cashier frees your hands. Once you have one, you only need to pick, stock and collect coins.
Oranges into juice. In the village and city markets the juice machine turns oranges into juice, which sells for twice the price of an orange. Keep its tray topped up.

Watching a video is always optional. On portals that offer it, the lightning button doubles the speed of everything for 60 seconds and the tree button fills every tree and shelf at once. Each saves you about a minute; you can finish every stand without them.

title: Fruit Stand FAQ
description: Answers about Fruit Stand: is it free, does it save, does it keep earning when I close it, does it work on phones and Chromebooks, and how prestige works.
body: Is it free? Yes, it is free to play in the browser. There is nothing to buy with real money.
Does it save my progress? Yes, automatically every few seconds and after every purchase. On CrazyGames it is saved to your account; elsewhere, in your browser.
Does it keep earning when I close it? If you have hired at least one helper, yes: when you come back you collect part of what your helpers earned, for up to two hours away.
Do the helpers fall asleep? No. Helpers always look for the emptiest shelf and keep picking and stocking. If every shelf is full, they walk around waiting for the next customer.
How long is it? The first stand takes about fifteen minutes, the whole game a little over an hour, and then you can start again with a permanent bonus.
Does it work on phones, in portrait and on Chromebooks? Yes. It plays with touch, mouse or keyboard, in portrait or landscape.
Is it a Monkey Mart copy? No. It belongs to the same family of cosy shop-management games, but the stands, fruit, juice machine, helpers, art and music are our own.
Can I turn the music off? Yes, with the speaker button in the top right corner.

title: Fruit Stand for Schools and Kids – Safe, Cosy, No Sign-up
description: Fruit Stand is a calm, text-free shop game that works on school Chromebooks: no chat, no purchases, no account and no personal data.
h1: Fruit Stand for classrooms and kids
body: Fruit Stand has no chat, no purchases, no account and no personal data. There is no timer and nothing to lose, so it is calm to play in short or long sessions.
There is no text in the game, only numbers and pictures, so it works the same for children who are still learning to read and for students of any language.

It is a gentle introduction to money and planning: every sale adds coins, every upgrade has a price, and players decide whether to save for a helper or buy a tree now. Prices go up step by step, which gives natural practice with comparing and adding numbers.
It runs in the browser on Chromebooks, tablets and phones, in portrait or landscape, and loads in a couple of seconds (1.7 MB).
